heading: How this site works
intro: This portfolio has no CMS admin area. The content lives in a git repository, editing happens on the very pages you are looking at, and every merge to master deploys automatically.
videoAria: Introduction video: how the portfolio stores its content in git, edits it live on the site, and deploys through GitHub Actions

steps.title: Live editing on the real pages
steps.body: Append ?edit to any URL. After an HTTP Basic prompt at the nginx proxy, the page you are looking at becomes the editor: text, tags, records and settings edit in place. Every save becomes a commit to a branch through the GitHub Contents API; on a conflict a three-way rebase keeps your edit.

steps.title: Git is the content store
steps.body: Content is JSON: language-neutral structure documents, per-language text dictionaries and per-page field manifests. Branches are previews — ?edit=preview lets you edit and view a branch before anything reaches master. No database, no admin panel.

steps.title: Merge to master, go live
steps.body: Pushing master triggers the GitHub Actions pipeline: a type-checked build, bilingual resume PDFs, and an rsync deploy to the VPS. Infrastructure changes redeploy the container through their own guarded workflow. From commit to live in minutes.
